scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tastecase/contracts && npm run build --workspace @tastecase/worker && npm run build --workspace @tastecase/api && npm run build --workspace @tastecase/runner
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @tastecase/web
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 supabase/foundation.test.ts supabase/discovery.test.ts supabase/review.test.ts supabase/comparison.test.ts && node --import tsx --test scripts/benchmark-discovery.test.ts
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @tastecase/contracts && npm run build --workspace @tastecase/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:web
